comments.author: Marco Reyes
comments.body: Staging flag auth_httponly_cookie is on for internal accounts; plan to expand to 5% of production traffic next week.

content.text: Staging flag auth_httponly_cookie is on for internal accounts; plan to expand to 5% of production traffic next week.
Auth tokens still land in localStorage under nimbus.session.v1. Any XSS on a marketing subdomain can steal long-lived bearer strings and call the Graph API as the victim until the 14-day TTL expires.

Switch the web app to the httpOnly session cookie path already used by the mobile BFF: Set-Cookie with Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, and a 12-hour sliding max-age. Drop the Authorization header injection from the SPA bootstrap and rely on credentials: include for same-site calls.
Complete when localStorage no longer holds session material, CSRF double-submit is wired for mutating POSTs, and the auth smoke suite passes on Chrome and Safari.
